original_ai_output.title_zh: NDC指责APC策划拉各斯袭击，执政党否认参与
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚民主党（NDC）指责全体进步大会党（APC）在拉各斯州伊凯贾对其支持者发动袭击，执政党否认参与。据称，疑似政治暴徒持砍刀、棍棒和石块闯入NDC一场市政厅会议，扰乱会场并迫使与会者逃离。事件引发袭击者与部分NDC支持者的对抗。目前该事件为单一来源报道，双方说法不一。

key_facts.fact: NDC指责APC在拉各斯对其支持者发动袭击，APC否认参与
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Nigeria Democratic Congress and the All Progressives Congress have traded blames over the attack on NDC supporters by suspected political thugs during a town hall meeting in Ikeja, Lagos State.

key_facts.fact: 据称持砍刀、棍棒和石块的暴徒闯入NDC市政厅会议会场
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: hoodlums armed with cutlasses, cudgels and stones reportedly invaded the venue, scattered chairs and forced participants to flee

key_facts.fact: 事件引发袭击者与部分NDC支持者的对抗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The incident triggered a confrontation between the attackers and some NDC supporters, who reportedly resisted the invasion by throwing chairs at the hoodlums.

uncertainties: 袭击者身份尚未确认，仅被描述为疑似政治暴徒
NDC对APC的指控未获独立证实，APC予以否认
事件目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
